blind.B1: Yes. GSE237736 is the series the paper deposits (S2.5.p6, S7.p1). 16 dentate gyrus RNA-seq samples, 2x2: p16 WT/KO x sedentary/12-day voluntary wheel running (S3.1.p1-p2). All 16 are sequenced; the running factor is in 8 samples (4 WT RUN, 4 KO RUN).
blind.B2: S3.1.p4, n = 4 per group (S2.10.p1): Set A KO RUN vs KO CTL, Set B KO CTL vs WT CTL, Set C WT RUN vs WT CTL, Set D KO RUN vs WT CTL, Set E KO RUN vs WT RUN, plus genotype x running interaction (GLM/LRT, 866 genes, S3.4.1.p1). Exercise contrasts: A and C; B is genotype, D and E mix genotype and running.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one dentate gyrus per mouse, one sample per mouse, independent animals (S2.10.p1 n = 4 independent per group). Packet A lists no candidate pairing key; the title/description replicate numbers are unique per sample. No blocking needed.
blind.B4: S2.5.p4: 'pair-wise differential expression analysis ... DESeq2 ... comparisons between expression levels ... in two different conditions', Wald test per comparison; S2.5.p5: separate LRT GLM (full vs reduced) for the interaction. The paper does not say whether dispersion was estimated on all 16 samples or per pair.
blind.B5: S3.1.p3: 'significance threshold of the p-value of differential gene expression (log_2 fold change) set to p-value <0.05' (DESeq2 Wald, raw p, no fold-change cutoff); S2.10.p1 also describes BH padj but the reported set counts use p < 0.05 (S3.1.p4). Counts: Set A 3,272; B 1,230; C 762; D 1,475; E 494; GLM interaction 866 (p < 0.05, LRT).

checks.evidence: paper_reconstruction/ownership: analyzable; running arm present in 8 samples (metadata trt: run 8). Matches B1.

design grp levels WTsed/KOsed/WTrun/KOrun = 4 each, matches B2 and S2.10.p1; GEO genotype/treatment fields agree with description (e.g. 1WTnoRun); no exclusions; controls are within-genotype sedentary for A and C.

design contrasts: A treatment KOrun vs control KOsed; C WTrun vs WTsed; B KOsed vs WTsed; D KOrun vs WTsed; E KOrun vs WTrun. All treatment/knockout-or-run versus control as the paper names them (S3.1.p4); Rgs14 log2FC -0.375 vs paper -0.38 confirms sign.
Independent animals, packet A candidate keys: none; covariance not_required with full-rank design (rank 4, residual df 12).

Paper: pair-wise DESeq2 comparisons (S2.5.p4) without stating whether the fit is joint; analysis fits one limma model ~0 + C(grp) on all 16 samples (run_joint_limma). Counts differ from the paper in places (Set B 1725 vs 1230, Set E 317 vs 494, D 1048 vs 1475), but matrix method also differs (FPKM vs counts), so the fit structure is not isolated as the cause.
checks.fix: Optional: add a sensitivity run fitting each pair of groups alone (4 samples per pair) next to the joint fit and report both counts.

checks.evidence: All male, same age, tissue and strain; no batch/lane field in GEO; recorded in covariance reasoning.

Deposited files are StringTie FPKM/TPM/Coverage only (GEO data_processing); FPKM -> log2(x+1) -> limma, not rounded into counts; paper route (htseq counts, DESeq2) recorded as blocked and as declared_deviation in paper_data_discrepancies. p-value histograms plausible (frac_p_gt_0.9 0.05-0.14). FPKM>=1 filter removes paper-validated low-expressed genes; a no-filter sensitivity run is provided.

Applied rule pvalue < 0.05, no fold-change cutoff, matches B5/S3.1.p3; BH padj < 0.05 reported as audit (0 genes in every contrast, minimum padj 0.066), and HANDBACK states the lists are nominal. paper counts fit raw p, not padj, so no discrepancy hidden.

HANDBACK table compares same sets at the same rule (p < 0.05); it reports mismatches (B 1725 vs 1230, E 317 vs 494) without claiming reproduction; interaction 619 vs 866 labelled as limma contrast in place of LRT.
No stop or refusal; the only blocked item is the DESeq2-on-counts route, and the claim that no counts are deposited matches the file list (StringTie gene_abundance tables in RAW.tar).

human_items: Joint limma model on all 16 samples versus the paper's pair-wise fits: the paper says 'pair-wise' but not whether the model was joint (open policy question).
summary: 该案例设计与论文一致：2x2 析因、每组 4 只独立小鼠、16 个样本全部使用，对照与方向正确，阈值按论文的原始 p<0.05 转录并报告了 padj 审计（0 个基因）。FPKM 无计数矩阵导致使用 limma(log2(FPKM+1)) 属于已声明的偏离，未发现阻断或主要问题。联合与逐对拟合是否一致论文未明确，列为待人工判断的开放问题。
